$comment: Optional compiled source mappings. Select matching brain.sourceAdapters explicitly; instance access policy is separate. `issues` projects issues.json (scripts/gen-issues.py); `github` projects the issue and pull-request mirror app/github.json (scripts/github_sync.py) into the kinds and edges below. Requires the engagement overlay, which declares the issue kind.

kinds.title: Pull Request
kinds.description: A mirrored pull request (make github-sync): state, draft, review decision, checks rollup, base/head and the issues it closes or references. Carries its repository's visibility.

kinds.title: Repository
kinds.description: A mirrored GitHub repository with its visibility (public, private or internal), so access rules can filter its records.

kinds.title: Milestone
kinds.description: A mirrored repository milestone (number, title, state, due date).

edges.description: A pull request closes an issue: GitHub's closingIssuesReferences or a closing keyword (Fixes #12) in its title or body.
A mirrored issue, pull request or milestone belongs to its repository.
A mirrored issue or pull request is scheduled in a milestone of its repository.
